documents.unit: Rutgers Office of Information Technology (all campuses)
documents.title: Guidance on the use of AI at Rutgers
documents.quality_note: Universitywide guidance: AI not permissible for coursework unless instructors say so; cites Academic Integrity Policy 10.2.13 ('impermissible technologies'). Same page serves all three Rutgers campuses.

documents.unit: OTEAR (Office of Teaching Evaluation and Assessment Research)
documents.title: AI in Education - OTEAR Rutgers
documents.quality_note: Long page mixing a few instructor recommendations and sample syllabus statements (brainstorm-only / fully permitted with citation) with many linked resources and event listings; policy content is a minority. OTEAR is based at New Brunswick but was listed as university-wide in the seed.

notes: Both documents are universitywide Rutgers pages shared with other campuses; no Newark-specific AI policy or computing unit policy surfaced.
